distribution.primary: IPFS-pinned local release payloads with Filebase-pinned mirrors
distribution.ipfs_status: payloads, helper, release page, docs, and manifest pinned to IPFS; helper and payloads also uploaded to Filebase for gateway fallback
distribution.note: This manifest records immutable IPFS CIDs, Filebase mirror CIDs, and SHA256 digests for the locally supplied pool-v6.5.7 payloads.

bootstrap.behavior: detects Linux host architecture, downloads the matching IPFS-pinned payload with Filebase gateway fallback, verifies SHA256, patches the packaged Dockerfile/startup/raw-datadir snapshot restore paths, installs operator seeds plus live stable public service-port peers, preserves the packaged bootstrap peers, writes the deduplicated merged peers into node.conf.example and BOOTSTRAP_PEER_ADDRESSES, uses S3 latest snapshot metadata and archive download for optional restore-first installs, disables host IPv6 by default to avoid Docker Hub IPv6 route timeouts, pre-pulls Docker base images with retry, extracts the payload, and runs the payload install.sh

peer_seeds.validation_result: Peer overlay pruned after snapshot-node feedback: SSM getPeerInfo on the Cape Town host found 9 live stable service-port candidates from the pool node and 1 from the snapshot node; temporary/high NAT ports were removed from the release overlay.
peer_seeds.next_requirement: Before each release, query operator nodes with authenticated getPeerInfo, keep only active public service-port peers with matching peer IDs, preserve packaged seeds, then validate a fresh install or restore until peers connect and chain segments import.
peer_seeds.selection_policy: operator seeds plus active public TCP 8150/8151/8152 Full|CF peers only; high observed NAT ports excluded

release_ipns.inbrowser_gateway_note: Do not use ipns.inbrowser.link for the mutable IPNS page; its browser-side IPNS resolver can reject otherwise valid Kubo-published records. Use ipfs.io for IPNS and immutable .ipfs.inbrowser.link URLs for exact CIDs.
release_ipns.purpose: mutable latest pointer for the tested IPFS release setup page

chain_data.status: S3 latest raw datadir snapshot used for restore-first installs; helper reads SHA256 and size from S3 metadata at install time
chain_data.compression: zstd tar archive despite the .tar.gz object key
